title: I revitalized an old game I made with the help of AI
author: abulero
selftext:
I've released a huge update last week: a complete visual overhaul of the UI, enemies, animations and effects with a huge help from Claude.

I decided to capture some clips and compare with a pre-overhaul build. What do you think about how it looks now?

The game: An incremental game where your tower throws hammers at waves of slimes. During a run you spend wood on upgrades that last until you lose. Between runs you spend emeralds, essence and crystals on permanent upgrades, 10 different hammers, 12 skills and three talent trees, and later you prestige.

Game link if you're interested, for Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cg.hammersurvival](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cg.hammersurvival)
